sampling: Same observed-complete target days as S8; naturally missing records outside/inside reference periods are retained as the starting observation process. Scheduled blocks end 21 days apart.
mechanisms: Random record each observed cow-day; one common shift throughout a farm block; lowest observed yield each cow-day (constructed yield-dependent stress).
interpretation: Not a real missingness mechanism or biological ground truth. Unavailable scores are reported separately; positive retention over all original positives counts unavailable scores as not recovered.
